proof_content: On the three-point path metric with initial servers at the endpoints, the alternating request sequence makes the proposed memoryless-transfer inequality fail at the middle point. This refutes only that transfer mechanism.
assumptions: The route uses the proposed memoryless transfer inequality
counterexamples: A three-point path instance refutes the proposed memoryless-transfer inequality, not the k-server theorem.
mechanism: hostile small-instance test of a memoryless transfer
